rows.ARS:
Light yellow Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Waon
rows.Origin:
Bred by Keisei Rose Nursery (Japan, before 2002).
Introduced in Japan by Keisei Rose Nurseries Inc. in 2004 as 'Waon'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, yellow center, lighter outer petals. None to mild fragrance. up to 30 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Large, full (26-40 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Waon = Accord
